system.description:
Counterfeiting is the time-honored art of illegally duplicating money—either clipping coins or cutting dies to replicate printed material.

Obstacles: Coin clipping, Ob 1. Die stamps, Ob 3. Coins, Ob 4. Printed material, Ob 5-10 depending on complexity.

FoRKs: Forgery, Whitesmith, Alchemy, Etching

Skill Type: Craftsman. Tools: Yes. Expendable.

Root: Per/Agi

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 266
